title: Digital Designer
description:
Our client in the UK is looking for a versatile designer to join the team permanently. This is a broad role that touches almost every part of the business - customer-facing creative work, production graphics, UI designs for our data visualisation products, and working on developing the design systems that underpin them. It's a role that rewards genuine range: the ability to shift between a brand campaign brief and a stat pack template, between a motion graphics package and a Figma component, without losing quality in the transition. Everyone on the team has real ownership of their work and real impact on the product and the brand - this role is no different.
Responsibilities

•
Customer graphics - campaign assets, social graphics, broadcast-ready visuals, and branded content for football clubs, media companies, and athletes.

•
T3 Studios and video production - graphics packages, motion-ready assets, templates, and visual support for our studios and production team.

•
Stat pack design - our stat packs are used by some of the world's leading broadcasters and rights holders as on-air production tools. Data-rich, visually precise, and built to perform in a broadcast environment.

•
Toolbox template design - our Toolbox platform lets clients generate their own graphics. You'll design templates that sit inside the product, balancing creative quality with the constraints of a data-driven system.

•
Design systems - we have two design systems: one for our stat packs and one for the Toolbox UI. You'll contribute to both by building out components, maintaining consistency, and helping us scale without losing quality.

Requirements

• Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite - Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects.

• Proficiency in Figma.

• Experience designing for multiple output formats - social, digital, and broadcast.

• Comfortable working across multiple projects and briefs simultaneously without dropping quality.

• High standards visible in portfolio detail; receptive to feedback and able to iterate.

• Self-directed - doesn't need to be managed to get things done.

• Good communicator - can take a brief, ask the right questions, present their thinking.

• Collaborative across design, product, and production teams.

Strongly Valued (Differentiators)

• Motion graphics or video production experience.

• Experience working within or contributing to a design system.

• Previous work in a creative agency, sports organisation, or media environment.

• Ability to pick up new tools and workflows quickly.

• Genuine passion for sport - particularly football.

Platforms & Tools

• Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects).

• Figma (UI, prototyping, design systems / components).

• Motion / video production tooling (After Effects core; bonus for Premiere / Cinema 4D / Lottie exposure).

• Awareness of broadcast-spec output (frame rates, safe areas, colour profiles, deliverable specs).

Character

• High standards - you care about the detail and it shows in your work.

• Good communicator - you can take a brief, ask the right questions, and present your thinking.

• Efficient - you know when to spend time and when to move fast.

• Receptive to feedback and able to iterate.

• Self-directed - you don't need to be managed to get things done.

• Collaborative - you're comfortable working across design, product, and production teams.

What You'll Get

• A role with genuine breadth and ownership - no two weeks look the same.

• Work that reaches real audiences in professional sport and media.

• A close-knit, high-quality team that cares about doing things well.

title: Senior Analyst - CX Automation Intelligence & Insights
locationText: New York, NY, United States; Newark, NJ, United States
description:
Senior Data Analyst 

This is a hybrid role to our Newark, NJ HelloFresh facility 

The role

As a Senior Data Analyst at HelloFresh, you will anchor the data strategy driving our aggressive, automation-first transformation. Our Global Customer Experience (GCX) team’s mission is to understand our customers’ journeys and empower market leads with insights and intelligent solutions that improve satisfaction, retention, and efficiency. We are moving fast to scale our self-serve rate, achieve 100% chatbot coverage, improve CSAT, and launch real-time, proactive incident communications via in-app CRM channels.

We need a strategic thought partner for our Product, Engineering, and CX Automation teams who brings a high bar of technical rigor. In this role, you will own our core automation analytics architecture (chatbots, voicebots, agent-assist AI, and customer self-reporting tools), dive deep into GenAI conversational landscapes, and translate complex log data into actionable roadmap strategies. If you love solving open-ended problems and want to directly shape the experience of millions of global customers, you might just be our missing ingredient.

What you’ll do

• Anchor the data strategy for our entire automation and chatbot analytics infrastructure, serving as the sole embedded analytics lead within the Global CX department.

• Proactively monitor user intents and trends to diagnose system bugs early and establish standardized, organization-wide KPIs for bot containment and NLP accuracy.

• Conduct deep-dive analyses of chat transcripts and user journeys, leveraging semantic clustering and LLM evaluation to uncover friction points and tune conversational flows.

• Continuously optimize and secure our reporting environment, ensuring data integrity, normalization, and advanced visualization techniques for critical executive decision-making.

• Partner closely with cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, and CX Automation) to translate complex customer log data and system requirements into sustainable roadmap strategies.

• Own and deliver core business reporting mechanisms and dashboards, including the Monthly Business Review (MBR) and EBIT reviews.

What you’ll bring

• A passion for driving automation-first transformations and solving complex operational problems within a fast-paced customer experience environment.

• Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL to handle increased domain complexity and secure our underlying reporting architecture.

• Experience with next-gen agentic workflow stacks (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) to optimize development and analytical speed.

• Proven track record of designing, implementing, and maintaining high-visibility BI solutions and dashboards that communicate trends clearly to Directors, VPs, and SVPs.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to lead complex data analytics projects and influence cross-functional partner

 

You’ll get

•

• Competitive Salary & 401k company match that vests immediately upon participation

• Generous parental leave of 16 weeks & PTO policy, as well as paid holidays off

• $0 monthly premium and other flexible health plans

• Amazing discounts, including up to 85% off HelloFresh subscription

• Emergency child and adult care services

• Snacks & monthly catered lunches

• Collaborative, dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company

 

This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the responsibilities. However, the Company reserves the right to adjust, modify, or reassign work tasks and responsibilities as needed to meet changing business needs, operational requirements, or other factors.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Machine Learning Infrastructure
description:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

WHY THIS ROLE?

As Cohere continues to grow, the size and complexity of our programs has continued increasing over time. To help us manage this, we are looking to bring in exceptional Technical Program Managers (TPM) to manage this!

At Cohere, TPMs are pivotal to our success, being seen as operational experts specializing in cross-functional efforts. Great TPMs at Cohere are well-rounded, executing with precision at the tactical level, while partnering with senior leaders and shaping the big picture at a strategic level, and the opportunities are endless in growing the scale and impact of their work. Cohere’s TPMs are often described by their stakeholders as organized, execution-oriented, pragmatic, and adaptable to the needs of the company and the programs they lead.

As a reward for the depth and breadth of expertize that you bring to the table, you will get to work alongside some of the most talented engineers in the world on building cutting edge AI technology. No day will be the same as the one before, and the dynamic high growth environment will be absolutely perfect for anyone excited about solving novel problems, bringing structure to oftentimes chaotic and fast-paced environments, and ambitious about scaling their own impact and growth alongside the company!

Please note: While we are remote-first and accept candidates from all over the world, we are strongly prioritizing hiring for candidates in the Eastern Time (ET) timezone.

- Manage the program portfolio covering inference, efficiency, serving, and endpoints to guarantee that Cohere’s infrastructure continues to scale for a rapidly expanding user base of internal and external users

- Lead the end-to-end coordination and execution across the program, with a particular focus on cross-functional collaboration with Modeling and customer-facing teams

- Identify pain points and establish processes to ensure that the team can focus on development, while meeting needs of internal and external users of the models, and improving engineering best practices

- Build a strong culture around continuous improvement, such as liaising with incident management leads, ensuring that problems are accurately root caused, and that required fixes are provided in a timely manner

- Manage various overlapping projects and programs, ruthlessly prioritizing asks, to ensure that the company’s top priorities are met

- Collaborate with stakeholders across the company to set, track, and manage timelines, deliverables, budgets, and scope to ensure successful program execution

- Deliver clear, timely, and consistent updates across engineering, leadership, and non-technical teams on the progress, plans, and incidents

- Act as a strong tactical and strategic partner to the senior leads across your program, whether that be providing low-level tactical support or help answer high-level strategic problems that drives impact at the company-level.

YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU HAVE:

5+ years of Technical Program Management experience focusing on Machine Learning Infrastructure

title: Creative Marketing Manager - ONYX
description:
[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png]

Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер - іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших.

Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі.
Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти - це ключова цінність SKELAR.

Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями - і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів.

ONYX - продукт, що створює цифровий імунітет та захищає спокій людей у світі, де приватність стала дефіцитом. Ми використовуємо AI, щоб не тільки знаходити проблеми, а й фіксити їх замість користувача. Автоматичне сканування та видалення витоків, персоналізовані тактичні місії під конкретний девайс і оператора, інтерактивні true crime серіали для підвищення Cyber IQ. Це продукт, що змінює ринок цифрової безпеки через AI-технології та персоналізований підхід.

У світі, де кіберзагрози стали частиною повсякденного життя, ми будуємо продукт, який змінює підхід до особистого цифрового захисту. Люди не хочуть бути гіками. Вони хочуть відчувати, що ситуація під контролем.

Ми шукаємо Creative Marketing Manager, який підсилить креативну машину - і зробить так, щоб про ONYX дізналися мільйони.

Що ти будуватимеш:
Один правильний хук може змінити те, як мільйони людей думають про свою безпеку онлайн. Бо саме creative вирішує, чи зупиниться людина - чи просто прогортає далі. Чи відчує, що це про неї - чи побачить чергову рекламу.

У кібербезпеці creative - це не про естетику, це про довіру.

Ти будуватимеш не окремі креативи, а систему: від гіпотези до тесту до інсайту - і знову, швидше кожного разу. Кожен winning creative - це канал, який масштабується. Кожен провальний - це дані, які роблять наступний кращим.

Автоматизація - не бонус, а частина роботи. У нас вже є власна AI-система генерації креативів, і команда активно інвестує час у її розвиток: нові інтеграції, нові формати, менше ручної роботи - більше простору для гіпотез. Ти тестуєш ідеї за години, а не тижні.

Що від тебе:
- Ти маєш глибоке розуміння як працює Meta Ads, вмієш аналізувати та працювати з метриками.
- Ти розумієш, чому один креатив зупиняє скрол, а інший - ні, і можеш це пояснити через дані.
- Ти тримаєш у голові працюючі концепції та тренди - і знаходиш нові кути там, де ринок уже вигорів.
- Ти перетворюєш потік ідей та референсів на систему: збираєш, систематизуєш, пріоритизуєш у гіпотези - і доводиш до сильного результату.
- Ти тестуєш системно: хук, візуал, меседж - окремо, з висновком після кожного циклу.
- Ти розумієшся на дизайні: бачиш, чому один візуал працює, а інший - ні, і говориш з дизайнером однією мовою.
- Ти даєш бриф так, щоб дизайнер зрозумів не "що намалювати", а "що має відчути людина".
- Ти працюєш з AI-інструментами як з частиною щоденного процесу, а не як з експериментом.
- Ти шукаєш, що можна спростити та автоматизувати - щоб час команди йшов на ідеї, а не на рутину.
- Ти міряєш себе результатом, а не кількістю зроблених креативів.
- Англійська B2+ - ти читаєш і пишеш хуки, які резонують з контекстом американської аудиторії.

Чому варто обрати саме цю роль:
Авторство замість брифів - ти сам створюєш creative-систему - мову бренду, hook-механіки, формати, що роблять складну тему близькою мільйонам. Місце, де творять, а не копіюють.
Прямий вплив на бізнес - твої creative безпосередньо впливають на CPA та unit economics з першого дня.
Унікальний досвід - побачиш запуск продукту з нуля, будеш частиною кожного рішення.
Чіткий шлях до керівництва - команда будується навколо тебе: 2-3 найми через 3-6 місяців, план до 30 людей за рік.

That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster.
Proudly based in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018. Since then we’ve raised a $72M Series C, been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte (Fast 500™), signed multi-year AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier, and grown to a team of 250+.
About the Role
CoLab’s go-to-market org is scaling across sales, BDR, and customer success. This role exists to make sure that growth is backed by real capability, not just headcount.
The short version: you’re a thought partner to GTM leadership who turns half-formed observations into programs that move numbers.
Here’s what that looks like in practice. An executive team member says, “I think our BDRs need a sharper point of view on personas and messaging.” You take it from there. You figure out where the gap actually is, write the messaging yourself, design the program, roll it out alongside BDR leadership with real checkpoints, measure whether it’s landing, and then hand ongoing management over so the program doesn’t live and die with you.
Or: stage two conversion is softer than it should be. You pull the data yourself or with RevOps, form a hypothesis or two, go audit the calls in Gong, and come back with a specific fix and a plan to roll it out.
Nobody is going to hand you a spec. The value you add lives in the distance between a vague concern and a program that worked.
The Team You’ll Build

•
Technical Enablement Specialist (hiring in the near term) - owns industry enablement, discovery and demo certification, and new product enablement

•
Field Enablement Coach (planned) - call review and scoring at scale, plus individual coaching

You’ll set the strategy for both roles and make sure they’re structured to be effective. You’ll also do this work yourself. You need to be able to sit down with a stack of Gong calls and find the pattern, not just direct someone else to.
Working Across the Org
Enablement here isn’t a sales-only function. You’ll build programs that hold together across sales, BDR, customer success, marketing, and RevOps, which means a lot of your job is convening the right people and driving a rollout that everyone actually executes.
What Success Looks Like
In your first 90 days, you’ll have audited the current state of enablement across the funnel, identified where reps are actually struggling using data and direct conversations, and shipped at least one program that addresses a gap you found.
By six months, new GTM hires are ramping measurably faster, there’s a repeatable onboarding program that doesn’t depend on you running it personally, and your technical enablement specialist is productive and pointed at the right problems.
By twelve months, enablement is a function the GTM org relies on rather than tolerates. You can point to specific programs and specific movement in the metrics they were built to affect, across both pre-sale and post-sale teams. Just as importantly, managers are sustaining those programs themselves.
What You’ll Own

• Act as a thought partner to GTM leadership, taking early signals and turning them into diagnosed problems and shipped programs

• Diagnose performance gaps using funnel data, call review, rep feedback, and partnership with RevOps

• Build and own onboarding for new GTM hires, with a clear focus on r

The Integrated Supply Chain Manager owns the end-to-end demand-to-delivery cycle for the market, bringing together demand planning/S&OP and logistics/order management into a single point of accountability.

The role supports overall business revenue and profit delivery through rigorous management of demand signals across product and customer channels, and through efficient logistics, fulfilment and order management execution.

The role partners Commercial leadership and works across multi-functional teams - Sales, Marketing, Finance, Logistics and Supply Planning - to assure alignment and sufficiency in the business plans to deliver anticipated demand, while ensuring smooth supply chain operations and best-in-class customer service.

This requires balancing every aspect of the supply chain: managing inventory levels and cost-to-serve, minimizing shortages, and delivering a responsive supply chain through high demand forecast accuracy and OTIF delivery performance, in adherence with global process design and regional/market strategy.

▪ Lead implementation and testing of new order management and logistics systems and process upgrades and maintain SOPs and business continuity/recovery plans.

You will manage a team of analysts and BI practitioners, set the analytics roadmap, and act as the senior analytics partner to Product, Supply, Finance, Engineering, Security, and Go-to-Market leadership.

Runpod's business is consumption-based and marketplace-shaped, which makes analytics genuinely complex. Demand-side revenue depends on GPU-hour utilization and workload mix across Pods, Serverless, and Instant Clusters, while supply-side economics depend on host behavior, capacity, and pricing. You will build the metric definitions, models, and self-serve layer that allow the company to reason about these dynamics consistently. Our analytics stack includes dbt and Dagster for transformation, Snowflake underneath, and Mode as our BI tool.

You will shape how Runpod uses data to make company-level decisions. You'll have the opportunity to define the metrics that matter, proactively identify business opportunities, build a scalable analytics operating model, and translate complex data into clear recommendations for executives and the board. Success means creating an analytics function that not only responds to the business, but helps lead it.

Responsibilities:

- Lead, coach, and grow a team of analysts and BI practitioners, including hiring, career development, prioritization, and raising the technical bar of the work.

- Drive company strategy proactively from a data perspective by identifying the data levers that can transform the business, quantifying opportunities, and delivering clear paths to action for leadership.

- Own Runpod's core metric layer, defining and maintaining consistent definitions for utilization, retention, net revenue retention, margin, and marketplace supply/demand health.

- Set the analytics roadmap in partnership with Product, Finance, and GTM leadership, balancing recurring reporting needs with deeper analysis that changes decisions.

- Drive analysis of consumption-based revenue and customer behavior, including cohort retention, expansion and churn on usage, savings plan adoption, spot vs. reserved mix, and serverless workload economics.

- Build the self-serve analytics layer so stakeholders can answer routine questions independently, reserving the team's capacity for higher-judgment work.

- Partner closely with Data Engineering on modeling, data quality, freshness, and SOC 2 requirements

description:
Joining Mines Saint-Étienne means committing to an institution where science and innovation build a more sustainable future . It is a school of excellence where everyone has the opportunity to unlock their full potential and contribute to tackling the challenges of tomorrow .
Ranked among the top engineering schools in France and recognized worldwide, our school, a member of the Institut Mines-Télécom , educates the talents of tomorrow while actively addressing major industrial, digital, and environmental challenges. By joining us, you become part of a community of 500 members of staff, 2,500 students and take part in an ambitious project: combining academic excellence, cutting-edge research, and positive societal impact.
The Institut Mines-Télécom brings together France’s leading Grandes Ecoles to tackle major industrial, digital, energy, and environmental challenges. With its eight public Grandes Écoles and two affiliated Graduate Schools, it is the leading public institute dedicated to engineers and managers. Together, we imagine and build a sustainable future by educating the leaders who will shape tomorrow’s transitions.

When technology meets medicine, the result is… the Center for Health Engineering (CIS)!
From innovative medical devices (biomechanics, biomaterials, nanoparticles) to digital twins of patients and hospitals, the CIS develops customized solutions to address today’s healthcare challenges.
🧠 Modeling, simulation, collective intelligence: our faculty members work hand in hand with doctors, industry partners, and institutions.
💙 One goal: to improve healthcare and people’s lives through science.

🎯 What we expect from you
As post-doc, you will be at the heart of our missions in research and innovation, assigned to the SAINBIOSE lab. SAINBIOSE (INSERM UMR 1059) brings together researchers from Mines Saint-Etienne (biomechanics, biomaterials and bioengineering), the faculty of Medicine from Jean Monnet University, Saint-Etienne University Hospital, Inserm and the French Blood Establishment. The global scientific objective of SAINBIOSE is a better understanding and of biostress in osteoarticular (LBTO team) and cardiovascular pathology (DVH team). Website: https://sainbiose-lab.fr/
Biomechanics, experimental and computational, is a major research topic of SAINBIOSE, which goes from modelling the mechanical behaviour of tissues to clinical and industrial applications, especially with the textile industry. In 2024, Prof Stéphane Avril and collaborators were awarded a grant from PEPR Digital health to develop a digital twin for patient-specific LVAD [1] solution combining cutting-edge machine learning, advanced simulation, and experimental techniques. This project entitled TwinHeart will take place in a research group having 15 years experience in biomechanics and mechanobiology ( https://emse.fr/~avril/ ).

We open a non-permanent position of post-doctoral fellow to join the Avril’s team working on TwinHeart project. The work will be carried out at Mines Saint-Etienne, within the SAINBIOSE research unit (Inserm U1059). It is based at the Centre Ingénierie et Santé (Hospital campus at the North of Saint-Etienne).

The objective of the post-doctoral fellow will be to develop innovative computational models (multi-scale digital twin, machine learning, growth and remodeling) in which we will calculate the vascular response to LVAD-induced mechanical alterations, particularly the local stiffening of the aortic wall. Previous studies indicate that such stiffening can lead to a significant increase in pulse wave velocity (PWV), which undermines the aorta’s natural cushioning effect. This disruption increases left-ventricular afterload and systolic pressure while reducing coronary perfusion, all of which contribute to adverse cardiovascular remodeling such as left-ventricular hypertrophy and fibrosis recognized risk factors for heart failure progression. Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Replit enables people to build software with AI. The infrastructure underneath that experience must make it straightforward to launch services, isolate workloads, and run reliable systems at scale.

We're hiring a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead Cloud Infrastructure: the shared infrastructure as code (IaC), networking, storage, compute, and service mesh platforms that Replit's product and platform teams depend on. You'll lead and grow an existing engineering team building and operating these foundations, including Kubernetes, shared edge networking, service mesh and workload identity.

This is a platform-building role with production accountability. You should be comfortable going deep on a design or incident while developing a team that does not depend on you for every decision.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own the cloud-platform roadmap. Lead the team's IaC, networking, storage, compute, and service mesh platforms. Translate product, platform, reliability, and security needs into sequenced outcomes, balancing foundational investment, lifecycle work, and delivery commitments against the team's capacity.

- Make infrastructure repeatable and self-service. Build maintained IaC interfaces for services, cells, connectivity, identities, and shared resources. Enable internal customer teams to provision infrastructure without bespoke coordination or dependence on individual experts.

- Operate what the team builds. Own platform availability, upgrades, isolation, recovery, and incident remediation. Maintain clear SLOs, sustainable on-call coverage, and primary and backup owners for critical systems.

- Stay technically engaged. Review designs and production changes, debug difficult failure modes, and use AI coding tools-including Replit-to prototype and automate. Apply rigorous review and verification to AI-generated infrastructure changes.

- Build and grow a high-ownership engineering team. Coach engineers, develop technical leaders, set clear expectations, manage performance, and hire against agreed needs. Delegate meaningful ownership as the team grows.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- Demonstrated engineering management. You have led and developed engineers, made prioritization and performance decisions, hired thoughtfully, and delivered through a team-not only acted as its strongest individual contributor.

- Software-oriented infrastructure depth. You have built and operated cloud platforms or distributed systems and can reason across infrastructure code, Kubernetes, networking, service identity, and stateful dependencies.

- Safe-change and production judgment. You have owned consequential migrations and incidents, can explain failure modes and rollback limits, and know when simplifying a system is better than adding another platform.

- Platform-product and engineering judgment. You understand internal customers, create interfaces other teams adopt, and make clear tradeoffs among reliability, developer autonomy, engineering effort, and workload efficiency.

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with multi-tenant, cellular, regional, or dedicated enterprise infrastructure.

- Familiarity with GCP/GKE, Terraform or similar IaC systems, Cloudflare, Envoy/Istio, SPIFFE/SPIRE, and managed data services.

- Experience with large-fleet rightsizing, infrastructure consolidation, or migrating CI compute without disrupting developer workflows.

- A track record using AI tools to increase engineering output while preserving production safeguards.

We’re looking for a Creator Community Manager to build, grow, and elevate the creator community around our platform. This person will own both the creator community and the creator experience, helping creators feel supported, engaged, and successful at every stage of their journey with us.

You will serve as the voice of creators internally and the face of our platform externally, shaping programs, feedback loops, education, and engagement strategies that strengthen creator trust and loyalty. - Excellent written and verbal communication skills

- Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Support, and Operations

- Analytical mindset, with the ability to use both data and creator feedback to drive improvements

- Empathy for creators and a genuine passion for helping them succeed

title: Principal Software Engineer - IBM i (AS/400) Connectivity
description:
OUR MISSION
At Redwood, we empower our customers with lights-out automation for their mission-critical business processes.

 

ABOUT US
Redwood Software is the leading orchestration platform for the autonomous enterprise, driving business transformation at the lowest total cost of ownership. Redwood empowers organizations to intelligently automate and orchestrate mission-critical business and IT processes across complex ERP, hybrid cloud, data and emerging agentic AI systems. Through its SaaS-first automation fabric-with AI embedded across the automation lifecycle-Redwood accelerates the path to autonomous operations. Backed by 30 years of experience and trusted by more than 50% of the Fortune 50, Redwood helps organizations unlock human potential to focus on innovation, growth and what’s next.

 

CORE VALUES
One Team. One Redwood
Make Your Own Weather
Obsess over Customer Success
Work the Problem
Be Curious
Own the Outcome
Respect Each Other

 

YOUR IMPACT

As a Software Engineer - Principal, IBM i (AS/400) Connectivity, you will help build a new connectivity agent that extends Redwood RunMyJobs (RMJ) natively onto IBM i (AS/400), enabling Redwood to support some of the largest enterprise automation environments in the market. You will join a small, senior team building this capability largely from first principles, validating assumptions on live IBM i partitions and making architectural decisions where modern documentation may be limited. This position is open across levels from Software Engineer to Principal as we build out the team.

• Design, develop, test, and maintain native software supporting connectivity and integration with IBM i (AS/400) environments.

• Build native job submission and monitoring, spool file and message/data queue handling, and CL/RPG program invocation capabilities.

• Integrate IBM i functionality with the Redwood platform through clean, versioned extension points using native host server APIs and/or IBM Toolbox for Java (JTOpen/jt400).

• Integrate security and per-user authorization using IBM i user profiles and authority concepts while extending Redwood’s existing identity and credential management capabilities.

• Troubleshoot complex system-level issues across IBM i, Unix, and Java environments.

• Improve the reliability, performance, security, and scalability of Redwood’s IBM i solutions.

• Partner with product managers, architects, and engineers to translate customer requirements into effective technical solutions.

• Participate in architecture discussions, design reviews, code reviews, testing, and release planning.

• Leverage agentic AI to accelerate implementation, testing, and documentation while independently verifying correctness against authoritative IBM i references.

• Document connector behavior and platform prerequisites for field and support teams.

• Contribute to team success through clear communication, shared responsibility for quality, and accountable ownership of goals and delivery commitments in a fast-paced, iterative agile environment.

 

YOUR EXPERIENCE

• 10+ years of professional software engineering experience with strong Java 8+ skills.

• Hands-on IBM i (AS/400) integration experience, including CL, native job/spool/queue APIs, IBM Toolbox for Java (JTOpen/jt400), and DB2 for i.

• Working proficiency in C, including ILE C on IBM i.

• Experience integrating with vendor host-server or RPC-style APIs over TCP/IP, including connection lifecycle management and error handling.

• Strong concurrency and multithreading skills, with experience building resilient, long-running monitoring components such as job polling and spool/file event detection.

• Ability to work effectively from primary technical sources, including IBM i host-server and API references, rather than relying solely on tutorials or unverified AI-generated output.

• Experience with modern DevOps practices and technologies, including Git, CI/CD, Docker, and Kubernetes.
